title: Recipe Definition
description: Schema for role composition recipes. A recipe references base roles and mixins to compose on demand, producing a fully merged role for a specific AI tool format.

description.description: What this recipe is for. Helps with discovery.

activation_phrases.description: Optional natural-language triggers for the Cursor router rule (e.g. "You are a C# backend developer").

compose.description: Ordered list of role paths to compose (without .yaml extension). Order matters: for priority-merge fields (tone, output_format), the first role wins. Typically: lifecycle role first, then layer, then language.

mixins.description: Mixin paths to apply after composition. Mixins add responsibilities and guidelines but do not override tone or output_format.

overrides.description: Override any field in the composed result. Applied last, after all merging. Use sparingly — if you're overriding a lot, consider creating a new base role instead.

min_tier.description: Override the computed minimum model tier.

rationale.description: Human-written explanation of why this tier/reasoning is needed.

model_recommendation.description: Override the auto-computed model recommendation. Use when the composition heuristic over- or under-estimates the needed model tier.
